metrics.name: processed_fps
metrics.formula: processed_frame_count / measured_elapsed_seconds

metrics.name: source_read_to_render_ms
metrics.formula: (render_complete_monotonic_ns - frame_packet_timestamp_ns) / 1000000

metrics.name: source_read_to_render_slope_ms_per_minute
metrics.formula: ordinary least-squares slope of source_read_to_render_ms against elapsed seconds multiplied by 60

metrics.name: source_read_to_display_submit_ms
metrics.formula: (post_cv2_imshow_monotonic_ns - frame_packet_timestamp_ns) / 1000000

metrics.name: sensor_to_photon_ms
metrics.formula: external synchronized sensor stimulus to measured emitted display light

metrics.name: frame_processing_to_render_ms
metrics.formula: (render_complete_monotonic_ns - processing_start_monotonic_ns) / 1000000

metrics.name: rss_mib
metrics.formula: resident_or_working_set_bytes / 1048576

metrics.name: rss_delta_mib
metrics.formula: rss_end_mib - rss_start_mib for the named interval

metrics.name: rss_slope_mib_per_minute
metrics.formula: ordinary least-squares slope of RSS MiB against elapsed seconds multiplied by 60

metrics.name: latency_continuous_growth_flag
metrics.formula: true iff four 30-second source_read_to_render_ms medians strictly increase and Q4-Q1 > max(20 ms, 0.10*Q1)

metrics.name: rss_continuous_growth_flag
metrics.formula: true iff four 30-second RSS medians strictly increase and Q4-Q1 > max(8 MiB, 0.05*Q1)

metrics.name: processed_frame_count
metrics.formula: count of frames completing render in the measurement interval

metrics.name: dropped_capture_frame_count
metrics.formula: count of newest-frame mailbox overwrites during the measurement interval

metrics.name: degraded_frame_rate
metrics.formula: degraded_frame_count / processed_frame_count

metrics.name: retained_source_read_to_render_sample_count
metrics.formula: number of source_read_to_render_ms samples retained for aggregation

metrics.name: retained_source_read_to_display_submit_sample_count
metrics.formula: number of source_read_to_display_submit_ms samples retained for aggregation; equals processed frames for GUI and zero for headless

metrics.name: color_name_accuracy
metrics.formula: correct_evaluated_cases / evaluated_cases

metrics.name: color_name_evaluated_count
metrics.formula: count of non-missing color-name cases in the stated slice

metrics.name: lighting_name_stability_rate
metrics.formula: color families with one unchanged predicted name across all three lighting conditions / evaluated families

metrics.name: segmentation_iou
metrics.formula: intersection_pixel_count / union_pixel_count; empty-empty is NOT_APPLICABLE

metrics.name: segmentation_adequacy_rating
metrics.formula: manual rating using protocol 0-3 rubric with recorded reason

metrics.name: segmentation_adequate_rate
metrics.formula: cases with segmentation_adequacy_rating >= 2 / evaluated segmentation cases

metrics.name: delta_e_original
metrics.formula: CIEDE2000 distance between the original corrected color pair

metrics.name: delta_e_cvd
metrics.formula: CIEDE2000 distance between the selected-profile simulated color pair

metrics.name: risk_score
metrics.formula: configured relative Delta-E00 loss multiplied by simulated closeness

metrics.name: risk_sanity_order_pass
metrics.formula: declared confusing-pair risk_score > same-profile control-pair risk_score

metrics.name: outside_recolor_mask_changed_pixel_count
metrics.formula: count of unequal source/output pixels outside hard recolor mask before outline and tag overlays

metrics.name: temporal_assistive_color_switch_count
metrics.formula: number of consecutive-frame changes in selected assistive target RGB after first selection

metrics.name: analysis_frame_id_mismatch_count
metrics.formula: count of attempted render results where analysis_frame_id differs from current frame_id

metrics.name: artifact_checksum_mismatch_count
metrics.formula: count of manifest SHA-256 values not matching exact artifact bytes

metrics.name: unconsented_tracked_media_count
metrics.formula: tracked media artifacts without valid consent/provenance or any tracked private/raw media

metrics.name: manual_baseline_completion_seconds
metrics.formula: wall-clock seconds for the declared manual region-selection task
